name: B10-0073/2026 (PPE) – Attempted takeover of Lithuania’s public broadcaster and the threat to democracy in Lithuania
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the attempted takeover of Lithuania’s public broadcaster and the threat to democracy in Lithuania
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion on events in Lithuania, where the government has cut funding for the national public broadcaster LRT and made it easier to dismiss its head. The Parliament condemns these moves as political pressure, says they break EU media rules, and asks the European Commission to investigate and possibly take Lithuania to court.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet; it is an opinion calling for EU action against Lithuania.
- **Who it affects:** Lithuania's government, the LRT broadcaster, its journalists and viewers.
- **What happens next:** The Commission must assess the situation and may start legal action.
